cohort: 1,690 women aged 18-49 years who had given birth within the last six months in the Tigray region of Ethiopia
finding: Postnatal care service utilization is very low (8%) in the Tigray region of Ethiopia, with factors such as urban residence, higher education, cesarean delivery, more antenatal visits, and planned pregnancy associated with increased utilization.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by cesarean section were more likely to receive postnatal services (OR 2.88, 95% CI 1.32, 6.29).
